svg.title: Drenzzz technical skills
svg.desc: Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Go. Frontend: React, Next.js, Astro. Backend: Hono, Elysia, Fiber. Desktop: Wails. Databases: PostgreSQL, Redis. Tools: Git, GitHub, Docker, Linux, Node.js, Bun, Vercel, Railway, Cloudflare.
